name: ladder
note: The agent ladder in game time: each player looks whenever a decision is useful and skips stretches that need none; careers of 20 retirements from a new game, run 1 scored against reference/scenarios/run1_fresh.json's objectives. The oracle tops it: the author steered by rollouts on copies of the game (docs/agents.md, The oracle); its careers set the ladder's cost (~20 minutes on 6 threads). Real time is projected by the human models in `humans`.
